title: /t/ sharing token link to a folder: Unresolved with the variant recorded (BC-011)

method.text: Recognised a sharing token link (/t/ variant, folder) for site SiteA. The token cannot be decoded without signing in, so the path, library and folder are unknown. Authenticated validation can resolve it.

site name from the sharing link (whether it lives under /sites/ or /teams/ is not known)
